from.place: ## Proof, affine case: the sentence identifying the cohomology via the vanishing of the higher direct images at the finitely many boundary points

title: Boundary higher direct images of the multiplicative group vanish
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field, let Cbar be a proper smooth connected curve over k [def-sc-curves], let S be a finite set of closed points, let C := Cbar minus S, and let j:C \to Cbar be the open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. For every geometric point x of Cbar [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] and every q=1,2, the stalk (R^q j_* G_m)_x of the higher direct image [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] of the etale sheaf G_m [def-sc-gm-torsor] is zero. At x in C this is because j is an isomorphism locally; at a geometric point over P in S it is H^q of the fraction field of the strict henselization [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit] of the DVR O_{Cbar,P} [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], which vanishes for q=1 by Hilbert 90 and for q=2 by vanishing of the Brauer group of that field.
